title: HyLaR: Hybrid Latent Reasoning with Decoupled Policy Optimization

sections_read: §2.1 Explicit Reasoning; §2.2 Latent Space Reasoning; Fig2
§3.2 Canvas compression/injection and joint SFT; Eq1
§3.3 DePO, vMF, decoupled clipping and KL; Eqs2–8; Fig3

rs.innovation_approach: HyLaR以中间图像压缩表示冷启动连续latent递归，再把文本位置与latent位置拆成不同权重、裁剪和正则。主文vMF球面理论与附录实际未归一化内积surrogate必须分开。
rs.key_step: 按动作表示分成Z/S；文本clip(0.20,0.28)、latent clip±0.05，L_tok+0.5L_lat；latent回放保存旧策略确定性mode而非vMF采样，实际使用未归一化内积评分。
rs.why_non_obvious: latent递归改变后续状态，分类token概率与连续表示密度的变化尺度不同；但数学上有效的单位球面KL不代表实际保留模长的实现仍有该保证。
rs.trigger_condition: When a sequence mixes categorical choices and recurrent continuous representations with different update sensitivity, apply partition-specific clipping and weights while checking the actual replay distribution and score geometry.

rs.abstract_strategy: Partition heterogeneous decisions by their representation and optimize each partition with a separately calibrated update constraint.
rs.abstract_key_step: Retain a reference trajectory, compare current outputs against its stored representations, and weight the partitions independently.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Equal clipping intervals need not imply equal update sensitivity, and relaxing a normalized derivation can remove its probabilistic interpretation.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When mixed representations react differently to parameter changes, separate their update controls and verify that the implemented scores satisfy the derivation assumptions.

objective.signal_routing: SFT文本CE；canvas位置MSE到LLM与未detach目标compressor，SigLIP2冻结。RL同轨迹组优势A_i路由到文本Z和latent S，但分权重/clip；文本KL到reference，latent anchor是旧rollout mode，不是同一个冻结reference。start/end控制token按文本类别理解，精确mask边界未列出。没有局部必要性/因果credit或效率奖励。
objective.normalization: mean+std within prompt group (EqS16); κ fixed in theoretical vMF; actual latent vectors unnormalized. Eq7 latent KL平均|S|；两项PPO token/sequence聚合分母未明确。α在标准化优势之外，不被reward std直接消除。
objective.invariance: 不是PBRS，无策略最优性保持定理；分clip/α/KL改变surrogate更新且共享参数仍互扰。仅单位球面理论的方向score对向量正尺度不变；附录实际未归一化保留模长，取消该不变性和严格KL解释。
objective.baseline_or_potential: 优势baseline为同题G=8 reward均值，没有critic/势函数/answer-now MC。旧latent确定性mode是几何锚点；文本KL reference与旧policy的关系未说明。accuracy judge为GPT-5，不是当前policy价值。
objective.degenerate_cases: 总reward相同则A=0；accuracy全0/全1组被[.1,.9]过滤（即使format不同也按accuracy过滤）。p(canvas或direct)≈0时无强制双分支/entropy下界；G=1会被binary accuracy过滤。无latent时S为空，Eq7需空集guard，论文未写。理论单位方向且θ=θold时cos=1且对hidden的局部一阶导为0，ratio=1、KL=0；这是读者解析条件推论，不是实现实测。κ=.01理论ratio∈[exp(−.02),1]，0.05下裁剪不会触发；不可把这结论套到未归一化实现。
objective.gradient_audit: normalized旧mode固定、同状态重算时∂cos(h,z)/∂h在对齐点为0；若实际训练有先前minibatch变化、状态不一致或未归一化norm通道则此退化不适用。论文未给update epochs/minibatch顺序、BPTT截断、teacher-forcing旧latent还是递归current latent、cache/position一致性、old latent detach契约，故不补完整梯度公式。
objective.implementation_equation_unknown_reason: 补充§1.3只说把cos-based terms全换inner product，没有完整ratio分母、KL常数/平移或Wκ实现；不擅自把1替成旧范数平方或宣称已知exact objective。

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: Table5同HyLaR-SFT8 checkpoint比较GRPO/DAPO/VLPO/DePO；Tables6–7固定其余超参测α和clip；TableS1规范化vs非规范化是直接区分主文理论与实践收益的关键对照；Fig4交叉train/test latent长度。

engineering.lesson: 当不同位置用不同动作表示且回放是确定性mode时，应先核对真正的采样、评分、归一化和stop契约，再调clip；否则可以把有效的内积surrogate误报成无偏PG或精确KL，且分clip并不能恢复缺失的直答支撑。
engineering.latent_distribution_and_replay: Appendix states no stochastic vMF latent sampling; stored old mode scored by both policies. Text temperature .9. Recurrent hidden replay/cache reconstitution and detach details unspecified. Norm relaxation actual κ=.01 base scale, not a calibrated concentration of a true normalized vMF behavior sampler.
engineering.stop_and_pixels: §3.1 describes canvas_end or maximum canvas budget; vocabulary projection/end-check cadence and whether fixed K overrides early stop unspecified. Format reward1 requires think→canvas start/end→answer (alternation allowed); optional zero-canvas route not documented. No external crop/API or new pixels at inference. SFT target images exist only during cold start.
engineering.reward_unknowns: accuracy binary via GPT-5; format binary; exact combined scalar coefficients/formula not specified; no cost reward. Source calls no stochastic latent sampling despite main text previously sampled phrasing.

relevance.how: 分clip只在ratio离1时作用；本项目每批一次更新的ratio恒1必须先测，不能直接迁移效应。
按位置调约束可做共享参数干扰对照，但未分参数/头也没状态级U_choice，不能说解决路由泄漏。
cold-start中间图像对齐先造交替行为；不能证明RL可凭空学无latent/abstain/recover。
轨迹优势仍广播到各类位置；不同clip不是逐次必要性信用。
end token+硬预算有界，未研究剩余预算条件化停止或停止校准。
确定性latent回放与实际未归一化score须对齐；可迁移行为/评分契约审计，但不等同本项目logit bias。
仍mean+std，未解决crop代价被归一化抵消；loss外α仅是通道权重。
分clip/小κ并不提供两个离散动作采样支撑保证。
